description: Create Supabase project and gather connection credentials
steps: Create Supabase account at https://supabase.com if not exists
Create new project named 'predmkts' in desired region (us-east-1 recommended for AWS proximity)
Wait for project provisioning to complete (~2 minutes)
Navigate to Project Settings > Database to retrieve connection details
Copy the 'Connection string' URI from the 'Connection pooling' section (port 6543, uses PgBouncer)
Copy the direct connection string (port 5432) for migrations and schema changes
Note the project reference ID (used in connection URLs)
Retrieve the database password from Project Settings > Database > Database password

description: Update Settings class to support both local Postgres and Supabase connection modes
steps: Add SUPABASE_URL optional setting to config.py (full connection URL when using Supabase)
Add SUPABASE_POOLER_URL optional setting for pooled connections (port 6543)
Add DATABASE_MODE setting with enum: 'local' | 'supabase' (default: 'local')
Update postgres_url property to return SUPABASE_POOLER_URL when DATABASE_MODE='supabase', else construct from POSTGRES_* vars
Add postgres_direct_url property for migrations (uses SUPABASE_URL with port 5432 when in supabase mode)
Add SSL configuration: when DATABASE_MODE='supabase', append '?sslmode=require' to connection URL
Add validation: if DATABASE_MODE='supabase' but SUPABASE_POOLER_URL is empty, raise clear error on startup
Update docstrings to document the two connection modes

description: Update SQLAlchemy session management for Supabase PgBouncer compatibility
steps: Research PgBouncer transaction mode limitations (no prepared statements, no session-level state)
Update create_async_engine() in session.py: add 'prepare_threshold=0' to connect_args when using Supabase (disables prepared statements for PgBouncer compatibility)
Add connect_args={'ssl': 'require'} when DATABASE_MODE='supabase'
Consider reducing pool_size for Supabase (free tier has connection limits)
Add pool_size=5 and max_overflow=10 parameters to engine (Supabase free tier allows ~60 connections, pooler helps)
Test that async sessions work correctly with pooled connections
Ensure create_tables() uses direct connection URL (not pooler) since DDL needs direct access

description: Update environment files and documentation for Supabase settings
steps: Update .env.example with new Supabase settings block (DATABASE_MODE, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_POOLER_URL)
Add example values showing the Supabase URL format: postgresql://postgres.[project-ref]:[password]@aws-0-[region].pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres
Document that POSTGRES_* vars are only used when DATABASE_MODE='local'
Create .env.supabase.example with production-ready template (DATABASE_MODE=supabase, placeholder URLs)
Update CLAUDE.md Required Environment Variables table with new settings
Add note that JWT_SECRET must be changed from default for production

description: Handle table creation in Supabase (schema already exists vs needs creation)
steps: Modify create_tables() to use direct URL (not pooler) for DDL operations
Add check: if tables already exist, skip creation (idempotent)
Test create_tables() against fresh Supabase project - verify users, watchlists, tracked_traders tables created
Verify table schemas match local Postgres exactly (column types, constraints, indexes)
Document that first API startup will auto-create tables in Supabase
Consider adding CLI command: 'prediction-data db init' for explicit table creation

description: Ensure local development with docker-compose continues to work unchanged
steps: Verify docker-compose.yml postgres service still works (no changes needed)
Verify DATABASE_MODE defaults to 'local' so existing workflows unchanged
Test full local dev cycle: docker compose up -d, uvicorn start, register user, login, CRUD operations
Document the two modes in a 'Database Configuration' section in README or CLAUDE.md
Add example commands for switching modes: 'export DATABASE_MODE=supabase' vs 'unset DATABASE_MODE'

description: Verify all API functionality works correctly with Supabase backend
steps: Set DATABASE_MODE=supabase and configure real Supabase credentials in .env
Start FastAPI with uvicorn and verify startup logs show Supabase connection
Test POST /api/v1/auth/register - create new user in Supabase
Verify user record exists in Supabase dashboard (Table Editor > users)
Test POST /api/v1/auth/login - verify JWT returned
Test GET /api/v1/auth/me - verify user data returned
Test PATCH /api/v1/auth/me - verify profile update persists
Test full watchlist CRUD: POST /watchlist, GET /watchlist, DELETE /watchlist/{id}
Test full tracked-traders CRUD: POST, GET, PATCH, DELETE operations
Test tier limits: add 7 tracked traders on FREE tier, verify 403 on 7th
Test GET /tracked-traders/activity - verify activity feed queries work
Verify all 1441 existing tests still pass with DATABASE_MODE=local

description: Add proper error handling for Supabase-specific failure modes
steps: Handle connection timeout errors (Supabase free tier pauses after 1 week inactivity)
Add retry logic with exponential backoff for initial connection (handle cold start wake-up)
Log clear error message if Supabase project is paused: 'Database is waking up, please retry in 10 seconds'
Handle SSL certificate errors gracefully with actionable error message
Handle 'too many connections' error (free tier limit) with clear message about connection pooling
Add health check endpoint enhancement: /health should return database connectivity status

description: Document Supabase setup and operational procedures
steps: Add 'Production Database (Supabase)' section to CLAUDE.md or create docs/supabase-setup.md
Document step-by-step Supabase project creation process
Document how to find and configure connection strings
Document the difference between pooler URL (6543) and direct URL (5432)
Document free tier limitations: 500MB storage, pauses after 1 week inactivity, ~60 connections
Add troubleshooting section: common errors and solutions
Document upgrade path: how to migrate to Supabase Pro if needed
Update RELEASE.md Exit Criteria to include 'Supabase production database configured'

description: Ensure secure configuration for production Supabase deployment
steps: Verify .env is in .gitignore (never commit Supabase credentials)
Verify SSL is enforced for all Supabase connections (sslmode=require)
Review Supabase dashboard: disable anonymous sign-ups if using direct DB access only
Consider enabling Row Level Security (RLS) on tables for defense-in-depth (optional for v1)
Document that Supabase password should be rotated periodically
Ensure JWT_SECRET is different from Supabase's JWT secret (we use our own auth)
Add note: do not expose Supabase service_role key (only anon key if using Supabase Auth, which we're not)

description: Final validation and production deployment checklist
steps: Create production Supabase project (separate from dev/test if desired)
Configure production .env with Supabase credentials
Run full test suite to verify no regressions
Deploy API and verify it connects to Supabase successfully
Create test user and verify full auth flow in production
Monitor Supabase dashboard for connection count and database size
Verify API latency is acceptable (Supabase in same region as other AWS resources)
Document rollback procedure: how to switch back to local Postgres if needed
